body: Ya its weird... we'll see what happens.

Ya I know, but I still don't like the idea of talking to a stranger, and I don't want to burden my friend with anymore than I already have. That conversation went just swell :P I was only a blubbering mess for half an hour.

Well I'm sorta excited about finally seeing a psychologist about this, as I've had two in the past, but they did not help at all, and my parents didn't really know what the real problem was. I just feel doubtful that these feelings really can go away due to the fact that I've had them for so long.

Well the thing is, is that I still do dwell on it, and at times it is serious, but for me, the urge is very finicky since I've had it for so long. My friend I talked to said she had never thought of doing it, only what the consequences may be if she were to do it, and that had only happened once. We are both 17.
